text: Program Description Architecture is a discipline that focuses on learning how to design architecture while also learning relevant basic technology courses. Main content of learning is through the analysis of a blank space, at the same time, according to the construction of room function requirements, the type of building (such as gym, cinema, residential, factories and other different type), construction technology and materials used in the construction, from the plane of the building, the exterior facade and the design of internal and external space from scratch. The scope of study ranged from simple room layout to the design of architectural groups of several blocks in the city. Duration 5 years
